mapper.select: select from mall_member_device where member_id=#{memberId} and device_identifier=#{deviceIdentifier}
select from mall_member_device where member_id=#{memberId} and member_device_id=#{memberDeviceId}
select from mall_member_device where member_id=#{memberId} and device_type='MOBILE' and primary_mobile='1' order by member_device_id limit 1
mapper.update: update mall_member_device set device_name=#{deviceName},last_login_time=now(),last_login_ip=#{lastLoginIp},update_time=now() where member_device_id=#{memberDeviceId} and member_id=#{memberId}
update mall_member_device set primary_mobile='0',update_time=now() where member_id=#{memberId} and device_type='MOBILE' and primary_mobile='1'
update mall_member_device set primary_mobile='1',update_time=now() where member_id=#{memberId} and member_device_id=#{memberDeviceId} and device_type='MOBILE'
update mall_member_session set status='EXPIRED',offline_reason='TOKEN_EXPIRED',update_time=now() where member_id=#{memberId} and status='ACTIVE' and expire_time <= #{now}
mapper.select: select from mall_member_session s join mall_member_device d on d.member_device_id=s.member_device_id where s.member_id=#{memberId} and s.status='ACTIVE' and s.expire_time>#{now} order by s.create_time,s.session_id for update

select from mall_member_session s join mall_member_device d on d.member_device_id=s.member_device_id where s.member_id=#{memberId} and s.status='ACTIVE' and s.expire_time>#{now} order by s.create_time desc,s.session_id desc

select from mall_member_session s join mall_member_device d on d.member_device_id=s.member_device_id where s.member_id=#{memberId} and s.session_id=#{sessionId} and s.status='ACTIVE' and s.expire_time>#{now}
mapper.update: update mall_member_session set status=#{status},offline_reason=#{reason},update_time=now() where session_id=#{sessionId} and status='ACTIVE'
mapper.select: select count(1) from mall_member_device_audit where member_id=#{memberId} and action_type='PRIMARY_MOBILE_REPLACED' and create_time>=#{sinceTime}
